title: FoGConcept: Identifying Interpretable Movement Concepts for Freezing-of-Gait Detection from Multi-Scale IMU Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.28262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Freezing of gait (FoG) is a disabling motor symptom of Parkinson's disease, characterized by an episodic inability to initiate or sustain effective stepping. Current inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based models can detect FoG accurately, but they fail to explain their predictions in terms of human-understandable movement concepts. A major contribution of this work is to identify nine human-understandable movement concepts encoded by a multi-scale FoG model, including gait initiation, rhythmic bilateral gait, trembling in place, shuffling steps, and pivot turns. These concepts recur across subjects, are functionally linked to the model's FoG decisions, and exhibit emergent specialization across short and long temporal contexts. translated_abstract: 冻结步态是帕金森病的一种致残性运动症状，其特征是阵发性地无法启动或维持有效迈步。当前基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的模型能够准确检测冻结步态，但它们无法用人类可理解的运动概念来解释其预测。本工作的一个主要贡献是识别了由多尺度冻结步态模型编码的九种人类可理解的运动概念，包括步态启动、有节奏的双侧步态、原地颤抖、拖步行走和原地转身。这些概念在不同受试者之间重复出现，在功能上与模型的冻结步态决策相关联，并在短时和长时时间上下文中表现出涌现式的专门化。在新的冻结步态数据集、更宽的时间上下文以及更深的骨干网络上重复概念发现过程，恢复出了相同且相对稳定的运动概念集合。据此，我们提出了FoGConcept，一个……
tldr: 本工作从多尺度IMU冻结步态检测模型中识别出九种可跨受试者稳定复现、人类可理解的运动概念，使模型预测能够以可解释的运动模式加以说明。
en_tdlr: This work identifies nine human-understandable movement concepts that are stably reproducible across subjects from a multi-scale IMU-based Freezing-of-Gait detection model, enabling interpretable explanations of the model's predictions.
